items.q: How long does a project take?
items.a: Typically one to five weeks, depending on the package. Starter takes about 7 days, Signature about 35. We confirm a date before we start.

items.q: What do I need to provide?
items.a: Your logo, texts and images, if you have them. No texts yet? Add our copywriting. We guide you through everything else.
You do. Once the final payment is made, the design, code and content are yours.
50% upfront to start, 50% at launch. Fixed price, no surprise invoices.
We host in the EU with SSL and backups from {hosting}/month, or hand everything over to your own provider. Your choice.

items.q: Can I change things after launch?
items.a: Yes. Small fixes are covered by your revision rounds. After that, choose a care plan or book work as needed.

items.q: Which languages do you build in?
items.a: English, German and Greek, written by humans and not machine-translated. Extra languages are available as add-ons.

items.q: Are prices with or without VAT?
items.a: See the note under the pricing. We state it clearly on every quote and invoice.
